A '''city''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bal'demnic/Legends|Bal'demnic]], containing [[Kon'meas Spaceport]]. In [[67 BBY/Legends|67 BBY]], the [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]] visited the [[City/Legends|city]] after [[Death/Legends|killing]] his [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Sith Master/Legends|master]], [[Darth Tenebrous/Legends|Darth Tenebrous]]. After searching the city for transportation off the planet, Plagueis stowed aboard the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Woebegone]]''.
